live_proof_plan.note: Stand offline at handoff. Plan to run once the dev stack (Tailscale 100.121.76.86:3000, PG :55432, Keycloak :8180, Flowable) is back, as a rank-and-file (non-owner) per D-064.
setup: Have a tenant with >25 real process instances across ≥2 definitions and ≥2 starters (start several via record on_create + explicit launch, by two different employees).
Log in as a rank-and-file employee WITHOUT constructor grants (the anti-case persona).
steps: 1. GET /api/processes (no params) → 200, body has {instances,total,limit,offset}; total = real instance count; instances.length = min(total,200); order = newest-first (startedAt DESC), ties by id.
2. GET /api/processes?limit=10&offset=0 then ?offset=10 → two disjoint pages, total constant, no row repeats across pages, deterministic order.
3. GET /api/processes?definition=<procKey> → only that definition's instances (total drops); ?status=running → only running; both compose with ?q=.
4. GET /api/processes?q=<substring of a source record's title / definition name> → the operator finds their instance by human text, никогда не по UUID (anti-case).
5. GET /api/processes?started_from=<iso>&started_to=<iso> → only instances started in the window; an instance outside is absent.
6. As employee X: GET /api/processes?mine=1 → only instances X started; as employee Y the same query returns Y's set (no cross-leak — FF-5).
7. GET /api/processes/<instanceId> → detail carries starterName + starterType (человеко-имя, not just a glyph); resolver called exactly once for the request (union of history completers + starter).
8. Negative: ?definition=<foreign-tenant procKey> and ?record=<foreign record> → honest-empty, never another tenant's rows.
9. Regression: an existing consumer (current /processes table) still renders — default limit 200 returns the full set for tenants ≤200 instances.
expected_red_flags_to_watch: starterName absent for all rows → resolveActorsDisplay not wired in server.ts composition root (best-effort degrade is acceptable, but investigate).
total not matching a manual count → fold window (≤500) exceeded; document/raise the window bound.
pagination showing duplicates across pages → sort not total (should be impossible given the id tiebreak; would indicate a data id collision).

risks_integration: Interim UI: until T-0654-b ships, the current dumb /processes table calls GET /api/processes with no pagination params → gets the default limit=200 (unchanged behavior for tenants ≤200 instances; >200 shows first page only, but the table is already in the scroll-slit that B fixes).

Fold window: filtering/pagination operate over the last ≤500 instances (readEvents cap). Deep history beyond 500 is out of scope (the projection is an audit fold, not a paginated table) — same bound the projection already had. Documented in ADR rejected-alternatives.
starterName is best-effort (T-0648 resolver): no resolver / unresolved actor / no-DB path → field simply absent; the frontend must fall back to starterType/starterId (never render a raw UUID).
listInstanceProjections is now called with {limit:500} on the list path (was default 200) — widens the fold window; additive, no behavioral regression.
friction_events: Worktree had no node_modules — ran npm ci (188 pkgs, ~8s) before any gate could run.

anti-case-lock caught a D-064 denylisted step-name literal ('Согласование') that I introduced in a TEST FIXTURE — fixed to a neutral term. The gate scans ADDED lines under src/ INCLUDING tests; fixture strings must avoid case-domain vocabulary.

Adding starter resolution naively made the detail route call resolveActorsDisplay twice (history + starter), tripping the T-0648 'exactly one call per request' invariant — refactored to fold the starter id into the history's single batch resolve.
